# More Logos at the Pump

Version 1.9.2 shows the right logo for more stations, including three new brands and several that fell back to the generic pump icon before.

## Logos

- **Oktan, Grüne and Roth Energie have their own logos.** Stations of these brands showed the generic pump icon, because the card had no logo for them. Thanks to @AHahne64 _[#106]_.
- **Every Q1 station gets the Q1 logo.** Only stations with the brand plain `Q1` got the logo. Stations reported under a longer brand, such as `Q1 Automaten-Tankstelle`, showed the generic icon. The card now gives every brand that starts with Q1 the Q1 logo, as it already did for Globus, Raiffeisen and others _[#106]_.
- **Brands with umlauts find their logo.** The card dropped ä, ö, ü and ß when it looked up a logo, so `Grüne` searched for `grne`. It now spells them out as ae, oe, ue and ss _[#106]_.
- **Fläming Tank shows its logo.** The logo was in the card but could never load, because its file name did not match the lookup. It loads now _[#106]_.

Nothing to change after updating. If you set a custom logo for one of these stations as a workaround, you can remove it.
